name: map-coloring-game
description: Map coloring puzzle game - fill regions with 4 colors, no adjacent same color

scripts.build: mkdir -p www && cp index.html app.js favicon.svg manifest.json sw.js www/ 2>/dev/null || true && cp -r core platform platforms www/
scripts.dev: npm run build && python3 -m http.server 8200 --directory www
scripts.android:prepare: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:build: npm run android:prepare && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run android:prepare && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
